description: T-0969 attempt 10: where Excel's Beta function B(a,b) switches method near b = 8 (B(1/2,7.5) is about -20 x 2^-53 off, t0969-beta-density-b). Column A a, B b = 6.5 to 9.5 by 1/32; C and D BETA.DIST(x,a,b,FALSE) at x = 0.01 and 0.03, whose relative error is that of 1/B(a,b) up to the small power-term noise. E, F, G: GAMMALN(a), GAMMALN(b), GAMMALN(a+b); H, I, J: GAMMA of the same, to test B(a,b) built from Excel's own Gamma functions.
